title: FilterRequest
description: SDK→Orchestrator wire format. Published to the orchestrator's input topic; for REGISTER/MODIFY/UNREGISTER the message key is the queryId (UUIDv4 string). For HEARTBEAT the message key is arbitrary — the body's queryIds list is authoritative. The orchestrator translates each FilterRequest into a per-filter-function QueryMessage (see query-message.schema.json) on the corresponding per-function control topic. Four commands: REGISTER (first-time, from SDK subscribe()), MODIFY (selector replacement, from setSelector/add-update methods), UNREGISTER (retract, from consumer close() or delete-selector), HEARTBEAT (periodic liveness signal from SDK Session, covering all of its live queryIds in a single message). The orchestrator treats UNREGISTER on unknown queryId as idempotent (silent success). REGISTER on existing queryId is idempotent only if all fields match (broker redelivery); mismatched fields are rejected. HEARTBEAT touches the lastSeen timestamp on each named QueryEntry; unknown queryIds are silently ignored.

command.description: Lifecycle command. REGISTER spawns or reuses a per-input-topic filter function and registers the query. MODIFY replaces the selector on an existing queryId. UNREGISTER retracts the query and tombstones it on every per-function control topic where it was published. HEARTBEAT refreshes the lastSeen timestamp on each queryId in the body's queryIds list.

inputTopics.description: Fully-qualified Pulsar input topic FQNs to filter. Mutually exclusive with topicsPattern. Required on REGISTER (with topicsPattern as the alternative). Ignored on MODIFY and UNREGISTER.

topicsPattern.description: Regex pattern matching multiple input topics (handed straight to the spawned filter function's Pulsar pattern subscription). Mutually exclusive with inputTopics. Required on REGISTER (with inputTopics as the alternative). Ignored on MODIFY and UNREGISTER.

outputTopic.description: Fully-qualified Pulsar topic the filter function fans matching messages out to. SDK-generated. Required on REGISTER. Ignored on MODIFY (the previously-registered outputTopic is reused) and UNREGISTER.

selector.description: JMS-selector expression. Required on REGISTER and MODIFY. Ignored on UNREGISTER. SDKs validate syntax client-side before publishing.

keyDeserializer.description: Fully-qualified class name (via Class.getName()) of the consumer-side key deserializer, when known. Used by the orchestrator to detect schema mismatches across registrations on the same input topic. Optional; null means the SDK is not asserting a key schema. Use FQNs only — short names will be treated as different from FQNs by the equality check.

valueDeserializer.description: Fully-qualified class name of the consumer-side value deserializer, when known. Same comparison rules as keyDeserializer.

valueSchema.description: Full description of the consumer's value schema, forwarded verbatim by the orchestrator into the per-function QueryMessage so the filter function can decode the message value for schema-aware filtering. Optional; null/absent for the byte[] and Kafka paths. A schema name alone cannot decode structured Avro/Protobuf values, so the definition travels too.

name.description: Schema name — Pulsar SchemaInfo.getName() (e.g. the POJO class name, or 'STRING').

type.description: Schema type — Pulsar SchemaType.name(): JSON, AVRO, PROTOBUF_NATIVE, STRING, BYTES, etc. PROTOBUF (non-native) is rejected by the SDK because the function needs the descriptor.

definition.description: Base64 of Pulsar SchemaInfo.getSchema(): the Avro .avsc text for AVRO, the JSON-schema text for JSON, the serialized descriptor for PROTOBUF_NATIVE. Null/empty for STRING/BYTES.

clientType.description: Indicates the SDK family producing the request. Required on REGISTER. Recorded in the registry entry. v1 has no per-clientType behavior; reserved for future routing decisions (e.g., output-topic placement for Kafka clients needing KoP-mapped namespaces).

queryIds.description: Required on HEARTBEAT — the list of queryIds the publishing Session still considers live. The orchestrator stamps lastSeen on each named QueryEntry; unknown queryIds are silently ignored (probably already-tombstoned by a prior UNREGISTER). Null/absent on REGISTER/MODIFY/UNREGISTER.

windowFromMs.description: Optional on REGISTER: start of a time window (epoch ms, on the log's clock: broker-entry time when the broker appends it, else publish time; 0 means from the beginning, never reported as truncated). Requires exactly one input topic. A windowed REGISTER reads the topic's history from windowFromMs on a dedicated filter instance. With windowToMs the output ends with a completion record (property __window_complete__=true); without it the window is open-ended: the historical matches end with a caught-up record (__window_caught_up__=true) and live matches follow. Null/absent for a live query.

windowToMs.description: Optional on a windowed REGISTER: end of the time window (epoch ms, inclusive), greater than windowFromMs. May be in the future: the window then ends at the last message present when the query was registered. Null/absent with windowFromMs set: an open-ended window.
